findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 5 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 17 questions numbered 1-17; by section: 5.1.2 2, 5.1.3 15.

17 five-mark questions in book order: long division into a mixed form, the theorem on equal polynomials, Case I by substitution and by equating coefficients, improper fractions divided first, Case II repeated linear factors, Case III irreducible quadratics (including a quartic factorized by completing the square) and Case IV repeated irreducible quadratics with and without a linear factor. All fractions are the portal's own; every step was recomputed in Python (sympy, check5.py). Book corrections followed: the division row +-6x -+12, (3x^2 + 1) for (3x^2 - 1), x - 1 = 0 in Example 2, the signs of Example 7.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
